## Statement

Static analysis of webpack bundles can recover the module graph.

## Verification Criterion

Recover >= 95% of modules on the benchmark bundle set.

## Experiment Notes

Parsing succeeded for all webpack 5 bundles in the set.

## Result

**Finding:** Static parsing recovered 97% of modules across the benchmark.

**Prototype / Proof:** `./tools/bundle-parser`
